originality: Independently syllabus-authored practice; no official past-paper provenance is claimed. All 100 were authored as separate tasks, rather than counted parameter variants.
catalogCheck: The repository catalog confirms the five topic/collection IDs. Its ibSyllabusSubtopics function returns [] for Maths; numeric codes were checked against the official SL sections (1.1–1.9,2.1–2.11,3.1–3.8,4.1–4.12,5.1–5.11).
scopeChecks: No induction, complex numbers, vectors, formal limits, related rates, implicit differentiation, differential equations or volume-of-revolution tasks.
No variance of discrete random variables, probability density functions, frequency-density histograms or hypothesis testing.
Graph transformations avoid the general f(ax+b) form excluded at SL.
Both calculator and feasible exact non-calculator work are represented.
structuralChecks: 100 unique IDs/titles/stems; 20 per topic; 50 medium/50 hard.
Each part has its own fully worked additive M/A/R scheme; all part and question totals match.
All SVG parsed as XML and checked against the repository prohibited-element rules; no remote resources.
Every task passed a distinct executable arithmetic, probability, substitution, numerical integral or derivative check.
limitations: Author review and computational checks are not independent human IB examiner moderation.
Difficulty is an editorial judgement and has not been calibrated against student performance.
External schema, KaTeX and rendered visual checks are handled by the integration review.
